**Regime: Risk-premium tape; carry crowded across all major longs (AUD, GBP, JPY, USD) — vol spike is the tail risk.**

• **GBP similarly fragile.** Policy room is gone (feasibility -0.65); growth soft; real yields no longer compensating (decoupled; mult -0.57). Carry at 93rd percentile on stretched valuation (+1.6). GBP/USD vulnerable to the same vol-shock trigger.

CAD: cheapest on the board (-1.81 valuation), improving macro (+0.49), rewarded yield regime — the cleanest long if you need one.

**Carry pair:** **AUD/JPY** — the crowded short-vol trade in its purest form; both at carry extremes, both vulnerable to simultaneous unwind.
